programs.title: Beyblade Burst Quadstrike
programs.desc: Skilled Bladers from all over the globe were chosen to compete in the Champion's Challenge Tournament, including Valt's fellow BC Sol Blader, Kit Lopez.

programs.title: Beyblade X
programs.desc: As the teams continue to clash fiercely in the White Star Battles, Toguro Okunaga and Pan Cho of Team Zooganic visit the Animal Castle—the home of the Manju Family, creators of their Beys—at the suggestion of Quinn Manju from Team Conquest.

programs.title: LEGO City Adventures
programs.desc: It's the day of the big rocket launch and the entire city has launch fever, but not everyone is excited for the right reasons; with the launch in jeopardy, the astronauts race against time to ensure a timely lift off.

programs.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures
programs.desc: George decides to take the family on a vacation to Costa Rica where he'll be filming a whale documentary. Barbie and friends land summer jobs at a water park in Malibu.

programs.title: Theatre Dome
programs.desc: Welcome to the TheatreDome where two teams battle for eternal acting glory! The band is rocking out with chicken drumsticks! Who will drum up a win and who will cluck under the pressure?

programs.title: LEGO DreamZzz
programs.desc: Our heroes lay low in Central Park at the new and improved Beau’s place, much to Zoey’s embarrassment, as he’s now a pacifist, granola version of himself called Light Hunter. There, they learn that the dream world has become a police state, with them as public enemy #1. They also meet Dreamsmasher’s replacement, D-Shock, who is determined to catch them.
